audio.opus.limits: Host libopus PCM16 decoding with manager commands 0-9, mono/stereo/multistream, 8/12/16/24/48 kHz, reset and 40/120 ms workspaces. Conservative workspace sizing and generic errors; DSP timing and multistream SetContext are not emulated. Z-A audio playback remains unqualified.

kernel.virtual_memory.limits: Opt-in 16 GiB alias layout with 4 KiB idempotent mapping, partial release, zero reuse and bounded physical/system budgets. System usage models host tracking and populated page-table spans, not exact Horizon slabs. Unmapped guest access protection is not emulated; larger host pages can retain unused subpage backing.

services.ipc.limits: TIPC supports inline data, PID, handles and map-alias buffers within the 256-byte TLS command buffer; no static buffers or domain messages.

cpu.relocations.limits: ELF64 NSO relative relocations only; RELR targets must stay inside their module and outside the relocation table.

cpu.symbols.limits: ELF64 NSO dynamic symbols. GNU-only tables use bounded buckets and chains; SysV nchain retains precedence when both tables exist.

cpu.jump_tables.limits: Byte/halfword relative tables can use a proved low-bit AND bound of at most 4096 entries across scheduled instructions. Each setup stays within a known function and 64-instruction window. Groups of at most 16 indirect branches require a local proof for every member; clobbers, calls and any direct, materialized, relocated or table edge bypassing setup reject the masked fallback.

gpu.surface_write.limits: Maxwell SUST/SURED storage-image writes and reductions are not implemented; translation, resource binding and synchronization need shared-core support.

gpu.api.limits: NVN 55 is qualified for ACNH 3.0.1 airport, island, indoor and save/reopen paths on Windows Vulkan. This does not cover the entire NVN API, other titles or DLC; storage-image writes and sparse remapping remain unsupported. See docs/ACNH-port.md.

cpu.exclusive_pairs.limits: 32/64-bit register pairs use atomic compare-and-swap with address/size reservations. Like single-register exclusives, identical-value ABA writes are not detected; CAS/CASP and MTE are not provided by this capability.

gpu.pool_mapping.limits: Sparse mapping and rebinding remain unsupported.

services.network.limits: Offline service responses only; online play is unavailable.

audio.routing.limits: REV12 biquads and additional effect types remain unsupported; the listed variants cover the tested legacy packet layouts.
